system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature, [Symphonic Branch]

You have developed an album of songs meant to raise your tempo and stop the flow of your enemies. These songs are known as your Symphonies. While they have predefined names here, you can name them as you please. You can prepare up to 2 Symphonies when you complete a long rest. You can prepare 1 additional song at 7th and 15th levels. You memorize prepared songs until you begin a long rest.

If a song would trigger as part of casting a Kashu Clan Hijutsu, its affects are only applied if the affected creatures fail their saving throw. If the Kashu Jutsu cast does not force a saving throw, then they must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC, suffering the songs effects on a failure.

Staccato Burst

Once per turn, when you spend Resonance, you can choose to release the stored vibrational energy in a sudden burst. All hostile creatures within 10 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 1d6 psychic damage for each Resonance spent.

Dissonant Chord

You gain the Dissonant Chord Melody that you can spend Resonance on.

Dissonant Chord. Once per turn, when you score a hit and deal either [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 1 Resonance to force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they lose concentration on 1 random jutsu they are concentrating on.

Subsonic Pressure

Once per turn, when you use the Overturn Burst Melody, if the target has ranks of Disorientation, the DR penalty or Resistance suppression lasts until they have no ranks of Disorientation.

Overtuned Frequency.

As a Bonus action, you concentrate on over tuning your Shinobi Instrument. Your Shinobi Instrument can hold up to 8 Resonance, and you can gain up to 2 Resonance per trigger, per turn, but you must concentrate on doing so as if you are concentrating on an A-Rank Genjutsu.

Sonic Cannon

You tweak your Shinobi Instrument, to allow you to release blasts of sound and wind, gaining the Sonic Cannon and Sonic Cannon Burst attacks.

When you take the Attack action, you can replace any number of attack you make with a Sonic Cannon attack. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, beginning at 7th level, you can make two Sonic Cannon attacks instead of one.

Sonic Cannon. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet. On a hit, you deal 1d12 force damage. If you roll a 10 or higher on the damage die, the target gains 1 rank of Disorientation. This attack counts as using your Shinobi Instrument for features that call for it.

Sonic Cannon Burst. As an Action, you spend all remaining Resonance, releasing it as an overwhelming shockwave, forcing all creatures in a 30-foot cone originating from you to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they take 1d12 force damage for every Resonance spent, or half as much damage on a successful save.

Piercing Tone

[Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] you deal with your Shinobi Instrument ignores resistance and treats Immunity as resistance while you have at least 4 Resonance.

Resonant Disruption

Your Shinobi Instrument acts as a passive shield against sound. When you would make a saving throw to resist the effects of a Genjutsu cast against you with the Auditory keyword, your Shinobi Instrument automatically spends 1 Resonance, to grant you advantage on this save.

Additionally, if you succeed, you treat your success as if you critically succeeded instead, if possible.

Subsonic Grip

You gain the Subsonic Grip Melody that you can spend Resonance on.

Subsonic Grip. Once per turn, when you deal damage with your Shinobi Instrument, you can spend 2 Resonance, to force the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you vibrate the fluid in their joints until movement becomes agonizing. They become Restrained in place until the end of their next turn.
